Method of Attack: Malware distribution via fake software sites advertised through Google Ads
Multi-stage infection process providing initial access to victim networks
Command and control (C2) via malware downloader
PowerShell script downloading and executing DLL malware
Impacted Systems: Victims of fake software download sites

Users of popular software programs impersonated (LightShot, Rufus, 7-Zip, FileZilla, LibreOffice, AnyDesk, Awesome Miner, TradingView, WinRAR, VLC, Slack, Microsoft Teams, TeamViewer, Adobe, W-9 IRS forms)
Attack Vector: Google Ads advertising fake software download sites
SEO poisoning to rank malicious sites in search results
Malicious MSI installers downloaded from fake sites
